title: Addressing function distance lower bound
statement: For every positive integer $m$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the $m+2^m$ input coordinates with $|J|\le 2^{m-1}$. If a Boolean function $g$ on the sign cube of dimension $m+2^m$ depends only on coordinates in $J$, then its relative Hamming distance from the addressing function is at least $1/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $m+2^m$
